page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc5.8xlarge is a compute-focused virtual machine belonging to the High Clock Speed instance family. Driven by the KVM hypervisor, this instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6149 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.1 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core.

Network connectivity on the ecs.hfc5.8xlarge provides a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance comes without bundled local storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be configured via network-attached block storage options. Additionally, this instance profile includes zero hardware accelerators such as GPUs and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

Because it provisions a lean 2.0 GB of memory per dedicated high-frequency core, the instance is structurally cost-effective for computational jobs where memory footprints are moderate. Workloads that match this profile include batch processing, distributed continuous integration builds, high-throughput web frontends, and compute-bound simulation services.
